patch.description: Updates the existing assignee name, preserving its ID and all task assignments. Names are trimmed, must contain 1–200 characters and must be unique ignoring case.

get.description: Lists models the agent can be asked to use. Codex and Gemini (Antigravity) are read from their CLIs; Claude aliases come from configuration. A failed listing returns source none with an error, and callers can still send any model ID.

post.description: Reads a local repository's current branch and local branches (most recently committed first, up to 200) so Base Git ref can be pre-filled and suggested. The path travels in the body to keep it out of URLs. isRoot is false when the folder is inside a repository rather than its root. Returns 400 when the folder is missing, relative or not a Git repository.

Opens the operating system folder dialog on the machine running the backend and waits for a choice. Available only when the providers response reports folderPicker true. Returns path null when the dialog is cancelled. Only one dialog can be open at a time (409).
Read-only structural validation. Valid does not certify skill availability, provider access, command execution or execution readiness.

get.description: Read-only local observations for preparing an immutable work order. Does not verify credentials/model access or execute work.

post.description: Prepare an immutable run snapshot and pending stage/step records. Reusing a requestId for this task returns the original snapshot. Does not dispatch execution.
Explicitly dispatch a prepared work order in its own worktree. expectedRevision is the run revision. Reusing the same requestId never redispatches work.
Explicit human decision for a waiting manual step. expectedRevision is the run revision; a decision requestId is idempotent for the same decision.

get.description: Read-only project run history, newest first, with captured task titles and pipeline versions.

put.description: Explicitly adopt acceptance criteria with stable IDs. Uses the project revision; captured work orders remain immutable.

get.description: Criterion coverage, immutable verdict history, command receipts and current verification context. Missing inputs never imply pass.

post.description: Record explicit operator QA after execution stops. Pass/fail requires current command evidence and an asserting test reference. Idempotent request ID; expectedRevision is the run revision.

get.description: Task-wide review rounds and persistent findings, current context and eligible independent assessments. Process completion is never approval.

post.description: Capture a raw independent review packet before builder explanations. expectedRevision is the run revision; requestId replays exactly.

get.description: Review packet, immutable findings and freshness. Builder reports are withheld until independent assessment is recorded.

post.description: Explicit review verdict bound to code and QA. Recheck every prior finding; fixed needs current code and successful verification. Does not accept the task or merge code.

get.description: Bounded repair policy, immutable scope and attempt lineage. Execution requires explicit advance; fresh QA and independent review remain required. Money usage is unavailable.

get.description: Read-only bounded catalogue for this project's explicit skill files and discovery roots. Entries retain exact IDs/sources, paths and byte hashes. Source coverage and unavailable/ambiguous references remain visible. Reading or selecting never installs, executes or verifies provider compatibility.

get.summary: Read configured deployment targets and retained deployment history

post.summary: Capture a merged revision for an explicitly authorized environment
post.description: Capture executes nothing. Target commands and probes come from administrator configuration. Exact request retries return the original capture.

get.summary: Read revision-bound deployment authority and immutable command receipts

post.summary: Approve, deploy, reconcile or explicitly recover a configured target
post.description: Deployment and recovery approvals are separate and bound to revision, environment and configuration. Persistent intents precede dispatch; restart and retries never repeat a command or merge. Recovery targets the recorded pre-deployment revision and original persistence snapshot; original failure receipts remain unchanged.

get.summary: Read model routes, invocation limits and enforcement capabilities

put.summary: Adopt explicit project model routes and work-order budgets
put.description: Optimistic project revision. Preparation executes nothing. Enabled policy pins requested models and requires explicit unmetered-cost consent for agents. Invocation reservations and elapsed time are enforced; hard token or currency caps block dispatch. Changed policy revokes pending work and cancels owned processes, retaining evidence.

get.description: Read-only catalogue; paths remain server configuration. No feed, levels or runtime events are adopted by default. Collection requires complete sanitized snapshots, bounded freshness and distinct upstream identities.

get.summary: Read configured analytics feeds and explicit metric rules
get.description: Read-only catalogue of configured source/application/environment, units, statistics, exact decimal thresholds and minimum reported samples. No paths, implicit metric policy or execution authority.

post.description: Atomically creates components, tasks, acceptance criteria and dependencies. Source and item keys identify previous imports, which are preserved. Explicit existingItemId adopts a task in this project without editing it. Unknown references, hierarchy/dependency cycles and stale revisions reject the entire import.
